clue.text: Recurring stuff about Lawrence causes distress

indicators.note: about means the first piece wraps round the second here

parts.note: a strain is a passage of music, stuff that recurs in a piece
T. E. Lawrence, Lawrence of Arabia, gives his initials TE

explanation.surface: Some repeated material concerning Lawrence is upsetting someone.
explanation.walkthrough: Calling a musical strain 'recurring stuff' is whimsical, as the blog notes. To straiten someone is to put them in hardship, which causes them distress.
explanation.definitionFit: To straiten is to put someone in difficulty or want, a verb sense matching bringing hardship upon them.

clue.text: It brings up and up — quote me!

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the pieces are read from the bottom, backwards

parts.note: to quote is to cite
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone boasting that a thing is uplifting and asking to be quoted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns the whole run CITEME into EMETIC; 'and' just links.
explanation.definitionFit: An emetic is a substance taken to make you vomit, which brings food back up.

clue.text: Ancient religious story related to sun god (first century)

indicators.note: related to is read as narrated or told aloud, so the word for a story is spoken

parts.note: a myth is a story
Ra is the Egyptian sun god
first is I, the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A tale about a solar deity dating from the first century AD.
explanation.walkthrough: 'related to' (told) makes MYTH a sound piece, MITH. '(first century)' then gives I and C.
explanation.definitionFit: Mithraism was an ancient mystery religion of the Roman Empire, so its adjective describes an old faith.

clue.text: Note way crime's committed — way is extreme

parts.note: ut is the old name for the note now called doh
MO, modus operandi, is a criminal's way of working
ST is short for street, a way

explanation.surface: A detective's memo that a criminal's method goes to the limit.
explanation.definitionFit: Utmost means of the greatest or most extreme degree, as in the utmost care.

clue.text: Gold inside pole for one of set in 10 with …

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold
the inside of the body is the tum, or tummy
N, north, is a pole

explanation.surface: Gold found within a pole, read alongside the next clue as a list of a set.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside' is not a container signal: it is the noun, a person's insides, the tum. The clue runs on into 6-across: the seasons, one of the bonus tile sets in mah-jongg, with winter, spring and summer.
explanation.definitionFit: Mah-jongg has four season tiles, and autumn is one of them alongside winter, spring and summer.

clue.text: Classical member of set in 10 and setter turn into flower

definitions.text: Classical member of set in 10 and setter

indicators.note: into means the turn letter is set inside the flower

parts.note: an aster is a daisy-like flower
U, as in a U-turn, stands for a turn

explanation.surface: An old wind and a puzzle setter turning into a flower.
explanation.walkthrough: Auster is the Roman south wind, a mah-jongg wind, and also the pseudonym of a Guardian setter.
explanation.definitionFit: Auster was the classical Roman name of the south wind, and also a crossword setter's pen name.

clue.text: … Westbury, 24 and 25

parts.note: the first half of the town name, West, is shortened to its abbreviation W
the second half of the town name, bury, means to inter

explanation.surface: Completes the previous clue: a set including the Wiltshire town Westbury and two other answers.
explanation.walkthrough: Westbury (a Wiltshire town) is split into West and bury. The clue continues 5-across: one of the set in mah-jongg with autumn, spring (24) and summer (25).
explanation.definitionFit: Winter is the season grouped with spring and summer, and in mah-jongg it is one of the four season tiles.

clue.text: Look for return of transvestite queen

indicators.note: return of means the pieces are read backwards

parts.note: in drag describes a transvestite outfit
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: Searching for a drag queen coming back on stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return of' turns DRAGER, giving the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To regard something is to look at it, as in he regarded her coolly.

clue.text: Setter's opening scenes with friend done straight

parts.note: the setter is I, so the setter's, the setter is, is I'M
Part I is the opening section of a play or work
an ally is a friend

explanation.surface: A crossword setter's first scenes with a friend, acted with a straight face.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something impartially is doing it fairly, without bias, which is what straight means here.

clue.text: The lion king has time to get across

parts.note: Aslan is the lion king of C. S. Lewis's Narnia books

explanation.surface: A lion monarch is given a moment to cross over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The lion king' suggests the Disney film; it is Narnia's Aslan.
explanation.definitionFit: Aslant can be a preposition meaning slantingly across, as in a beam lying aslant the path.

clue.text: Contest to remove right from officer swallowing heroin (named "horse", they say)

indicators.note: swallowing means the trimmed officer takes the heroin letter inside it
to remove means the letter for right is dropped from the officer

parts.note: a major is an army officer
H is slang for heroin
n. is the abbreviation for named or name
gee-gee is what children say for a horse, written as two G letters

explanation.surface: A competition where a horse-riding officer on drugs has his rights stripped.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface is near-nonsense, so read it piece by piece. Neatly, heroin is also slangily called 'horse', echoing the bracketed hint.
explanation.definitionFit: Mah-jongg is a tile game played competitively, so a game of it is a contest between players.

clue.text: Family acting as source of 17

definitions.meaning: Timothy ..., Prunella Scales and their son Samuel are a well-known British acting family
the zephyr is the wind that blows from that compass point

explanation.walkthrough: Timothy West and Samuel West are British actors. It is also one of the four wind tiles in mah-jongg.
explanation.definitionFit: The West family are famous actors, and the zephyr is by definition the wind from the west.

clue.text: Set in 10 like 11, say, after tea

parts.note: char is British slang for tea

indicators.note: say means the word is spoken, so its sound rather than its spelling counts

parts.note: the Wests of 11-across are a family of actors

explanation.surface: A tile set compared, over a cup of tea, to a theatrical family.
explanation.walkthrough: Only the sound of 'actors' matters, so the spelling with an E is fair. Mah-jongg tiles include a suit called characters.
explanation.definitionFit: Mah-jongg has a suit called characters, tiles showing Chinese numerals one to nine.

clue.text: Among religious group one gets to drink endless DDT

parts.note: among is in
a sect is a religious group
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: endless means the last letter of the drink is cut off

parts.note: cider is a drink

explanation.surface: A member of a sect drinks the pesticide without stopping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' cuts CIDER to CIDE.
explanation.definitionFit: DDT is a well-known chemical pesticide used to kill bugs, an example of the category.

clue.text: Opener at 10 'e's associated with abroad, we hear

indicators.note: we hear means the phrase is pronounced and the result spelt differently

parts.note: 'e's, Cockney for he's, plus twinned, linked with a town abroad

explanation.surface: A dropped-aitch speaker says someone has links overseas.
explanation.walkthrough: In mah-jongg the dealer is East and the east wind round comes first. A British town 'twinned' with a foreign town is formally associated with it.
explanation.definitionFit: Play in mah-jongg starts with the east wind round, so that wind opens the game.

clue.text: Absence of wind instruments after party left

indicators.note: after means the instruments come behind the party and left letters

parts.note: a do is a party
drums are musical instruments

explanation.surface: No wind instruments after the party's over and people have gone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wind instruments' looks like one phrase; 'wind' belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The doldrums are equatorial ocean regions known for calms, where ships were stuck with no wind.

clue.text: Make a hole in the capacity of classical member of set in 10

parts.note: to bore is to drill a hole
as means in the capacity of, as in acting as chair

explanation.surface: Drilling into the volume of an ancient member of a set.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capacity' suggests volume; in the capacity of is AS.
explanation.definitionFit: Boreas was the Greek god of the north wind, and north is one of the mah-jongg wind tiles.

clue.text: Garment for one of set in 10 with 14, 5 down and 16

definitions.meaning: Chambers lists the word as a light garment or fabric

definitions.text: one of set in 10 with 14, 5 down and 16
definitions.meaning: the winds of mah-jongg alongside east, south and north winds

explanation.walkthrough: The classical west wind joins the east, south and north winds of 14, 5 down and 16.
explanation.definitionFit: Zephyrus was the Greek west wind, and a zephyr is also a light shawl or fine fabric.

clue.text: Take off accent, if so

indicators.note: off means the letters are disordered, gone off

explanation.surface: Advice to drop an accent if it is needed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Take off' looks like one phrase, but 'Take' is the definition and 'off' rearranges ACCENT IF SO.
explanation.definitionFit: To confiscate is to take property away by authority, a direct synonym of take.

clue.text: Tense withdrawal of service first from tables and chairs

indicators.note: withdrawal of means these letters are taken out

parts.note: tables and chairs are furniture
RN, the Royal Navy, is one of the armed services
I, the Roman numeral, is the first number

explanation.surface: A waiter clearing away tables and chairs is a strained moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tense' looks like an adjective, nervous; it is the grammatical tense.
explanation.definitionFit: The future is a verb tense in grammar, alongside past and present.

clue.text: Lovely to see and hear the tower?

indicators.note: hear means the tower's name is spoken, giving a word of the same sound

parts.note: the Eiffel Tower in Paris

explanation.surface: A tower that is a delight to look at and to listen to.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyeful is a striking or attractive sight, something lovely to see.

clue.text: Song was wrong

definitions.meaning: a German art song for voice and piano, as by Schubert
told untruths, was in the wrong

explanation.definitionFit: A Lied is a German song, and lied is the past tense of telling falsehoods.

clue.text: Have a pound to pay on bottle top and cloth

indicators.note: on means the debt piece is placed after the bottle top

parts.note: a teat is the top of a baby's feeding bottle
to owe is to have to pay, and L is a pound, giving OWE plus L

explanation.surface: Paying a pound for a bottle top and a cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bottle top' suggests a cap; it is a baby's feeding teat.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea towel is a cloth used to dry dishes after washing up.

clue.text: Gross part of grain belonging to former solver

parts.note: the ear is the seed-bearing head of a cereal plant
thy is the old word for your, the solver's

explanation.surface: A coarse bit of cereal once owned by a crossword solver.
explanation.definitionFit: Earthy humour is coarse or crude, which is what gross means here.

clue.text: Well bound

definitions.meaning: a natural source of water rising from the ground

explanation.definitionFit: A spring is a water source like a well, and to spring is to leap or bound.

clue.text: Calculator of number in old part of Iraq

indicators.note: in means the number goes inside the ancient land

parts.note: Sumer was an ancient region of southern Mesopotamia, now Iraq
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, a number

explanation.surface: A device for counting found in an ancient Mesopotamian site.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is read as one who sums, a calculator, not the season.
explanation.definitionFit: One who sums figures is literally a summer, a whimsical word for a calculating person or device.
